title: Orthotic case: flaccid drop foot after peroneal nerve injury
referral_text: Patient P-3305, 46-year-old male, 90 kg, 183 cm. No amputation. Right foot drop following common peroneal nerve injury after a knee dislocation 4 months ago. Flaccid dorsiflexor weakness (MRC 1/5), no spasticity, ankle passively mobile with full range, no medio-lateral instability. Knee stable after surgical repair, quadriceps 5/5. Walks unlimited distances, works as a warehouse supervisor on his feet all day, wants to jog again. No comorbidities.
